title: review_findings
description: Sub-call output contract for ONE finder lens in the multi-agent REVIEW workflow (#73): the findings that lens surfaced, reusing review.json's issue-object vocabulary so _issue_fingerprint applies unchanged.

findings.description: blocking/advisory findings this lens surfaced (empty when the lens found nothing). Reuses review.json's issue-object shape exactly — file:description is the convergence fingerprint; severity gates disposition at synthesis.

severity.description: suggestion findings can't block (they skip adversarial verify and auto-approve at the severity gate); critical/important get verified and drive the fix cycle

tests_meaningful.description: the find:tests lens's independent test-validate verdict (#13/#541): do the change's tests meaningfully exercise it (would they fail if it regressed)? An explicit false is vacuous. true needs a mutation_checks entry that failed a test, or a tests_not_checked_reason. Answer it whenever there are tests to read; answer null only when the change has genuinely no test surface. Only the find:tests finder emits this.

mutation_checks.description: #541: the mutations the find:tests finder applied to prove tests_meaningful. Only the find:tests finder emits this.

failed_tests.description: ids of the tests that failed on this mutation; empty means it survived

blocking.description: #614: whether this SURVIVED mutation (empty failed_tests) opens a fix cycle. The engine, not the reviewer, acts on it: true only when the mutation sits on behaviour the task spec requires or on a guard the project marks money-path/safety, and it needs a non-blank blocking_reason naming which, or the engine demotes it (evented). Every other survivor is reported once as a noted gap in non_blocking, never as a blocking issue. Defaults to false. Ignored on a mutation that failed a test

blocking_reason.description: #614: required when blocking is true: the spec requirement or money-path/safety guard this survivor falls on. A blocking survivor with no reason is demoted to a noted gap

tests_not_checked_reason.description: #541: why no mutation settled tests_meaningful. Accepted in place of proof and evented as unproven. Only the find:tests finder emits this.

improvement.description: self-improvement loop: the single highest-value forward-looking improvement this lens suggests for the PROJECT/roadmap (not a fix for this PR). Omit unless a maintainer would independently prioritize it. The engine folds one across lenses in fixed lens order.

disposition.description: same filing threshold as review.json's improvement. Choose `file` deliberately, with justification, to file an enhancement issue. `fixup`: apply in-place this PR. `fix_now`/`drop` and an absent disposition are surfaced in the completion note, not filed.

retrospective.description: self-improvement loop: one lesson this lens teaches about the ORCHESTRATION PROCESS (prompts/stages/tooling/lanes), not the code. The engine folds one across lenses in fixed lens order. Omit if none.

detail.description: what we learned / what to change

target.description: optional concrete harness artifact this lesson concerns
